evidence.note: Clean title slide: serif headline, sans subtitle, italic byline, ample whitespace; consistent header and nav used on every slide.
Three-node reward loop with colour-coded arrows and check badges; definition tile sits directly under the diagram; nothing collides.
Insight overlay uses the same card, kicker and serif style as on s-4 and s-5 steps; background properly blurred.
Numbered timeline left, server/internet diagram centre, quote tile right; uncluttered and well aligned, though right third above the quote is empty.
Densest slide: folder icons crowd against the Package mirror box, the Automated scorer card sits over swarm lines, and the 'never read transcripts' label runs past the servers panel edge.
Research-programme panel with coordinator tree is tidy; quote tile kicker 'PHASEONE[BIG]' reads oddly but styling matches other quote tiles.
Three parallel insight cards with consistent heading, bullet, quote and source treatments; faint blurred remnants of the previous diagram/legend show behind the cards.
Close slide mirrors the title slide's treatment; consistent.

rationale: Typography, cards, overlays and diagram language are consistent and purposeful across every slide, with diagrams that carry the story rather than decorate it. The s-5 evaluation diagram is noticeably more crowded than the rest, with icons and cards pressing against or overlapping other elements and a label overrunning its panel. That one slide below the rest matches level 4.
